name: trailhead-rec.program.search
description: Search municipal recreation programs by query, category, facility_id, or open seats.

name: trailhead-rec.program.get
description: Fetch full details for one program, including seat availability and optional missing-asset warning.

name: trailhead-rec.household.get
description: Inspect household roster, credit balance, member waivers/skills, and passes with virtual-time-derived pass expiry.

name: trailhead-rec.household.update_member
description: Update a household member's emergency_contact or preferred_facility_id (waivers and medical notes cannot be modified by Agents).

name: trailhead-rec.enrollment.list
description: List household enrollments with virtual-time-derived effective_status (including offer_expired) without mutating state.

name: trailhead-rec.enrollment.get
description: Fetch a single enrollment with its virtual-time-derived effective_status.

name: trailhead-rec.enrollment.preview
description: Check program eligibility (age, prerequisite skill, signed waiver, fee, open seat vs waitlist, household credit) without mutating state.

name: trailhead-rec.enrollment.enroll
description: Enroll or join waitlist for a program, deducting resident/non-resident fee from household_credit_cents when seated.

name: trailhead-rec.enrollment.accept_offer
description: Accept a pending waitlist offer before offer_expires_at, verifying waiver & credit and transitioning to enrolled.

name: trailhead-rec.enrollment.decline_offer
description: Decline a pending waitlist offer cleanly.

name: trailhead-rec.enrollment.withdraw
description: Withdraw an enrolled or waitlisted registration, calculating virtual-time refund tier (100% before full cutoff or during penalty_free_until, 50% before partial cutoff, 0% after).

name: trailhead-rec.court.search
description: Search open athletic court slots by facility_id, sport, or indoor flag.

name: trailhead-rec.court.book
description: Book an open athletic court slot, deducting fee from household_credit_cents.

name: trailhead-rec.court.cancel
description: Cancel a confirmed court booking, refunding 100% if virtual_now <= free_cancel_cutoff_at.

name: trailhead-rec.enrollment.transfer
description: Transfer an enrolled registration to another open eligible program, marking the prior enrollment transferred and settling any fee difference against household credit.

name: trailhead-rec.court.booking.modify
description: Reschedule a confirmed court booking to another open non-past court slot, settling any fee delta against household credit.
